property.name: defaultBrand
property.label: Default Bank Brand
property.description: Bank brand ID: truist | ally | citizens | citi | bofa

property.name: customBrandLabel
property.label: Custom Bank Name (optional)
property.description: Adds a custom bank to the Demo settings brand list, themed from Custom Brand Primary Color

property.name: customBrandPrimary
property.label: Custom Brand Primary Color
property.description: Hex color for custom bank brand (e.g. #0057B8)

property.name: showDemoControls
property.label: Show Demo Controls
property.description: Presenter only. Adds a faint Demo settings button (bottom-right) with the brand switcher. Ctrl+Shift+B hides or shows it. Leave off for customer-facing pages.

property.name: greetingName
property.label: Greeting Name
property.description: First name for the greeting when the page has no Contact record (e.g. Priya).

property.name: logoStaticResource
property.label: Logo Static Resource Name
property.description: Name of the Static Resource in Salesforce containing the bank logo image (e.g. BofA_Logo). Leave blank to use text fallback.

property.name: logoHeight
property.label: Logo Height (px)
property.description: Height of the logo image in the header banner, in pixels.

property.name: fallbackCreditScore
property.label: Fallback Credit Score
property.description: Score shown when no Contact record or Credit_Score__c field value is available.

property.name: premiumCardPageUrl
property.label: Premium Rewards Card — Apply URL
property.description: Experience Cloud page URL or external URL for the Premium Rewards card Apply Now button.

property.name: cashCardPageUrl
property.label: Cash Rewards Card — Apply URL
property.description: Experience Cloud page URL or external URL for the Cash Rewards card Apply Now button.

property.name: showGetStarted
property.label: Show: Open an Account
property.description: Show or hide the Open an account task.

property.name: showCreditCards
property.label: Show: Credit Cards
property.description: Show or hide the Credit Cards task.

property.name: showLoans
property.label: Show: Loans
property.description: Show or hide the Loans task.

property.name: showChecking
property.label: Show: Checking
property.description: Show or hide the Checking task.

property.name: showMortgage
property.label: Show: Mortgage

property.name: showCreditScore

property.description: Show or hide the Credit Score task.
